message: V15.2 introduces Verdant's built-in updater. Projects older than V15 use the cumulative upgrade base; V15 projects can use the smaller latest patch.
notes: Remote ad rotation now includes ad-03.
Future poster uploads can sync into ads.json automatically.
Update Manager shows installed and latest published versions.
Download + Import Latest fetches the published Unity update package.
YouTube RC3 cleanup removes unnecessary overlay/background layers.
VRCLinking defaults now match the live Tier ... Discord role names.
